criteria.name: data_understanding
criteria.reason: Charts identify actual category/segment/service dimensions, but no saved overview, cleaning rationale, schema or reproducible analysis.

criteria.name: numerical_accuracy
criteria.reason: Figures preserve real numerical comparisons and service/margin labels; no saved executable source or numeric verification, retained invalid/duplicate population and extreme prices undermine finance.

criteria.name: hidden_patterns
criteria.reason: Saved plots show category margin gap, service/region reliability, monthly pattern and segment shares; no five documented findings with methods, business meaning or limitations and no anomaly/event investigation.

criteria.name: visualization
criteria.reason: All six panels visually inspected and identical across attempts: readable titles, comparison bars/labels, segment pie and delivery histogram. Generic dollars, unexplained margin target and contaminated population prevent full chart credit.

judgment.summary: Needs revision: No analysis.py, findings.json or report.md is saved, so figures and console observations lack reproducible analytical provenance.; Initial explored financial results were based on a population that still included duplicate/invalid sales and did not establish robust anomaly treatment.; No five substantial documented findings, source-column links, limitations or supported recommendations have been delivered.
limitations: Output-only judgment; no runtime/speed/efficiency points and no GPT-assisted repairs or Astra output included.

Candidate code never executed or imported on host. Saved original/snapshot outputs and independent public-source completion reviews used; automatic quality scores and private expected-answer matching not used.
Large prepared CSVs examined by complete row/column/missingness/key-validity scans plus samples; consequential public-source recomputations reused from documented independent reviews.

Visualization scope: direct all-six contact-sheet review for Qwen9, Gemma12 attempt3 and Coder Next; public full visual evidence reused for Qwen27 and GPT-OSS attempts1/3, sampled visual evidence plus generator inspection for GPT-OSS attempt2. No claim that every plotted point was verified.
judgment.rubric_basis: Same public-prompt output rubric, weights 15/20/20/15/15/15. hidden_patterns means substantive unexpected-pattern investigation, without a private answer checklist; incomplete outputs earn only demonstrated partial credit.
